business_problem: Stone needed to replace a fragmented mix of messaging systems with one governed, low-latency streaming backbone that could support financial transactions, compliance, and faster platform delivery at scale.
solution_summary: Stone standardized on Confluent Cloud to replace a patchwork of RabbitMQ, AWS SQS, Azure Service Bus, and MSK that had forced its platform team to context-switch across incompatible tools and operating models. The managed streaming platform now provides a shared backbone for event-driven banking applications, including PIX instant-payment flows and other mission-critical transaction paths. Confluent Connectors let Stone provision integrations quickly for its data bus initiative, while Schema Registry enforces data compatibility, observability, and governance across banking domains that must meet regulatory requirements. The result is a platform with automated cluster management, autoscaling, and embedded governance that supports more than 1,500 developers, moves sensitive workloads off older on-premises tools, and gives product teams a more predictable way to build compliant real-time services.
